basic.name: Sandra Chaparro
basic.about: I'm transitioning from software engineering into cybersecurity, exploring different areas of the field to discover where my interests and strengths align. I'm building my cybersecurity foundation through certification study and self-directed learning, while bringing the technical perspective and problem-solving skills I've developed through software engineering.

roadmap.title: Software Engineering
roadmap.description: A Computer Science degree and hands-on software engineering experience — production applications, APIs, authentication and authorization, databases, and web development. The foundation I'm building security knowledge on top of.

roadmap.title: Security Foundations
roadmap.description: Formalizing that foundation into cybersecurity knowledge through certification study (CISSP, Security+), core security concepts, and continued learning — turning that knowledge into hands-on practice next.

roadmap.title: Security Exploration
roadmap.description: Developing practical understanding through hands-on learning and research — exploring areas like threat intelligence, OSINT, threat hunting, and AI security to identify where my technical skills and investigative mindset fit best.

roadmap.title: Cybersecurity Career
roadmap.description: The goal: a cybersecurity role where I can apply my problem-solving ability, engineering background, and investigative mindset, alongside the security knowledge I'm building, to help solve real security problems and keep people, data, and organizations safe.

securityJourney.narrative: My move into cybersecurity isn't a cold start — production engineering kept putting real security work in front of me: protecting patient data, securing APIs, and completing federal compliance training. This is a continuation of that work, not a departure from it.
applied: Implemented authentication and authorization middleware protecting sensitive patient data in a production healthcare EHR.
Built JWT-based authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) to safeguard protected health information (PHI).
Completed FedRAMP compliance training covering security controls, authorization requirements, and best practices for federal data.
learning: Studying for the CISSP certification (ISC2) — in progress.
Studying for CompTIA Security+ — in progress.
Applying security-first practices in day-to-day development work while building toward threat intelligence, OSINT, threat hunting, and AI security.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built full-stack features for a specialty healthcare EHR — secure payment processing, appointment scheduling, and product sales modules serving 15+ practitioners.
Diagnosed and resolved critical performance bottlenecks by optimizing inefficient MySQL queries, cutting API response time from 3.5s to 207ms (a 70% reduction).
Strengthened API security by implementing authentication and authorization middleware across endpoints, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive patient information.

experiences.title: Web Developer
bullets: Designed and deployed responsive websites for small businesses, optimizing SEO, page performance, and Core Web Vitals to improve search visibility, load times, and cross-device usability.
Partnered directly with business owners to translate needs into high-performance web solutions.
Deployed client websites through GitHub-integrated Vercel workflows for automated builds and production deployments.

experiences.title: Computer Science Tutor
bullets: Provided individualized instruction to 10+ students in Java, JavaScript, and C++ through hands-on coding and pair programming.
Designed and implemented a curriculum focused on Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) best practices, resulting in a 35% improvement in student code quality metrics.

experiences.title: Software Engineer Co-Op
bullets: Developed a centralized React dashboard with OAuth 2.0 authentication integrating the Jira API, providing real-time project visibility across sites.
Built responsive Bootstrap front-end interfaces, improving page load performance and data interactivity.
Completed FedRAMP compliance training covering security controls, authorization requirements, and industry best practices for services handling federal government data.

education.title: B.S. in Computer Science and Information Systems Engineering
bullets: Delivered full-stack projects using Java, JavaScript, PHP, and C++ with a 100% on-time completion rate, deployed on Heroku and Netlify.

projects.title: DR Tile Solutions
projects.description: A business website for a tile and remodeling company, with services, a project gallery, service areas, and FAQs built to drive quote requests.

projects.title: MC the Barber
projects.description: A website for a local barbershop featuring a gallery, testimonials, location details, FAQs, and booking/contact functionality.

projects.title: Salvatierra Digital
projects.description: The website for my own web development business, offering custom website development, SEO, and ongoing website support.

projects.title: Raptor CRM
projects.description: A mobile-first CRM replacing a paper notebook for a user juggling two sales roles — car sales and independent medical insurance — keeping both client lists organized and quick to access between calls.

projects.title: Dental Practice Management System (EHR)
bullets: Architected a multi-tenant EHR platform enabling seamless support for multiple dental practices from a single codebase.
Developed RESTful APIs for appointment scheduling, treatment tracking, payment processing, and product sales.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based access control, protecting sensitive patient health information.

projects.title: Grocery Inventory Management System
bullets: Developed a full-stack React application that suggests 100+ recipes based on available ingredients and auto-generates grocery lists.
Integrated a third-party recipe API and designed a MongoDB backend to store API responses and user preferences.
